Transaction in Own Shares AI Summary Close X RS Group plc purchased 150,739 ordinary shares in the week 16–20 November 2026 under its £100 million repurchase programme, with daily volume-weighted average prices of 797.0782p (16/11), 784.7645p (17/11), 787.9702p (18/11), 781.5803p (19/11) and 758.8846p (20/11). Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 23 November 2026 RS Group plc 23 November 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 16 November 2026 to 20 November 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange.
